flow_error_flow_template_control_nested: Content controls cannot contain other content controls. Move the inner control outside its parent in Word.
flow_error_flow_template_control_placeme: Use rich-text controls between body paragraphs and text controls inside a body paragraph. Controls in tables, headers or footers are not supported.
flow_error_flow_template_control_unsuppo: This content-control type is not supported. Use rich-text controls for sections and text controls for fields.
flow_error_flow_template_control_untagge: A content control is missing its tag. Assign a unique tag in the control properties in Word.
flow_error_flow_template_no_controls: The template has no content controls. Add tagged content controls in Word, replace any text placeholders and upload the template again.
flow_error_flow_template_corrupted_archi: The Word template appears to be damaged. Try opening and saving it again in Word.
flow_error_flow_template_download_audit_: The template download link could not be created because required audit logging is unavailable right now. Try again later.
flow_error_flow_template_invalid_archive: The uploaded file is not a valid Word template (.docx). Choose a .docx file and try again.
flow_error_flow_template_in_use: This template is used by a published version of the flow and cannot be deleted. Change the flow's template and publish it again, then delete the template.
flow_error_flow_template_macro_not_allow: Macro-enabled Word files (.docm/.dotm) are not supported as templates. Save the file as .docx and try again.
flow_error_flow_template_missing_content: The selected Word template could not be read because the file content is missing. Upload the template again.
flow_error_flow_template_missing_require: The file does not look like a valid Word template. Check the file and try again.
flow_error_flow_template_not_accessible: The template is not available to you in this flow or space.
flow_error_flow_template_read_only: You can use this flow but cannot replace its template. Ask a flow editor to replace it.
flow_error_flow_template_unsupported_ext: Only .docx files can be used as templates. Choose a .docx file and try again.
flow_error_typed_io_contract_violation: The step's result does not have the required format. Check the result and the step's instructions in the step details.
flow_error_typed_io_contract_not_checked: The step's JSON, or the arguments of its tool call, could not be checked against the required format within the time limit, or the check failed. A large value or a complex format takes longer to check; the value was not found invalid.
flow_error_flow_model_capacity_undeclare: The selected model has no limit set for how much text it can take in or write. Ask an administrator to set both limits before starting a new run.
flow_error_flow_llm_output_truncated: The model reached its answer length limit before finishing. Reduce the material or how much the answer should contain, or ask an administrator to review the model's limits before starting a new run.
flow_error_flow_llm_output_whitespace_ab: The model got stuck and stopped writing anything meaningful, so the call was stopped. What the model managed to do is unknown. Ask an administrator to look at the model before you start a new run.
flow_error_flow_llm_request_timeout: The call to the AI model took too long, but the AI service may still have finished the work. Check the run before retrying, or the work may be done twice and cost twice as much.
flow_error_flow_step_timeout: The step did not finish within its time limit. Check the run before retrying: if the step used an AI model, the AI service may still have finished the work. Run again with less material, or ask an administrator to raise the normal time limit per step.
flow_error_flow_step_timeout_exceeds_ten: A step's time limit is higher than the organisation's maximum step runtime, so the step did not start. Ask a flow editor to lower the step's time limit, or an administrator to raise the maximum step runtime.
flow_error_flow_provider_rate_limited: The AI service is temporarily receiving too many requests. Wait a moment before starting a new run.
flow_error_flow_provider_unavailable: The AI service did not respond. Check the run before starting another, because a request may already have gone through.
flow_error_flow_provider_call_evidence_p: The record of the call to the AI service could not be saved reliably. Do not retry straight away. Check the run first, because the AI service may have done the work, and contact support with the run ID before running the step again.
flow_error_flow_evidence_export_too_larg: The run holds more evidence than one export can contain. Open the run's evidence to see what fits and exactly what was left out.
flow_error_flow_runtime_input_not_consum: The files you uploaded are not used by any step. Ask a flow editor to connect them to the right step, or run without them.
flow_error_flow_mapped_provider_call_lim: The step runs per file or item and may exceed the organisation's limit for calls to the AI service. Use fewer items or files, or ask an administrator to raise the limit.
flow_error_flow_summarization_non_conver: The summary could not be completed within the step's limits. Use less material or ask a flow editor to request shorter intermediate results.
flow_error_flow_long_material_partial_co: The material was too long for the step's model and was read in parts, but only partly. Use less material, or ask a flow editor to raise the step's time limit, choose a larger model or add a review.
flow_error_flow_unsupported_output_mode: The step uses processing that Eneo cannot run. A flow editor needs to choose another option under Result and publish the flow again. Then start a new run.
flow_error_flow_unsupported_output_type: The step uses a response format that Eneo cannot produce. A flow editor needs to choose another response format and publish the flow again. Then start a new run.
flow_error_typed_io_validation_failed: The step's material or result did not pass the check. Open the step details, fix the material or settings, and start a new run.
flow_error_typed_io_variable_resolution_: The step refers to something in the flow that is missing or cannot be read. A flow editor needs to open the step, fix the reference and publish the flow again. Then start a new run.
flow_error_typed_io_audio_invalid_file_t: One audio file has an unsupported type. Upload a supported audio file and start the run again.
flow_error_typed_io_audio_missing_file: The audio step is missing its audio file. Add the audio file and start the run again.
flow_error_typed_io_audio_source_unsuppo: The step gets audio from an unsupported source. A flow editor needs to set it to accept uploaded files or audio from an earlier step, and publish the flow again. Then start a new run.
flow_error_typed_io_audio_too_many_files: The audio step received too many files. Remove extra files and start the run again.
flow_error_typed_io_audio_exceeds_limit: The recording is longer than Eneo allows here, or becomes too large when decoded. Split the recording or ask an administrator to review the audio limits.
flow_error_typed_io_document_source_unsu: The step gets documents from an unsupported source. A flow editor needs to set it to accept uploaded files, and publish the flow again. Then start a new run.
flow_error_typed_io_empty_extraction: No text could be read from the uploaded file. Use a file with readable content and start the run again.
flow_error_typed_io_file_not_found: A file the step needs no longer exists. Upload the file again and start a new run.
flow_error_typed_io_file_source_unsuppor: The step gets files from an unsupported source. A flow editor needs to set it to accept uploaded files, and publish the flow again. Then start a new run.
flow_error_typed_io_http_connection_erro: The step could not reach the service it fetches from or sends to. Try again later, or ask a flow editor to check the address.
flow_error_typed_io_http_invalid_config: The step's HTTP settings are invalid. Ask a flow editor to fix them and publish the flow again.
flow_error_typed_io_http_invalid_url: The address in the step is invalid. It must start with http:// or https://. Ask a flow editor to fix it and publish the flow again.
flow_error_typed_io_http_malformed_respo: The service's response could not be read. Ask a flow editor to check that the service answers in the format the step expects.
flow_error_typed_io_http_non_success: The service the step called answered with an error. Try again later, or ask a flow editor to check the service.
flow_error_typed_io_http_response_too_la: The service's response is too large for this step. Ask a flow editor to fetch less data.
flow_error_typed_io_http_ssrf_blocked: The address in the step is blocked by network safety rules. Use an allowed address, or ask an administrator to review the rules.
flow_error_typed_io_http_timeout: The service did not answer in time. Try again later, or ask a flow editor to fetch less data.
flow_error_typed_io_tool_invalid_config: The step's tool configuration is invalid. Check the selected tool and its arguments.
flow_error_typed_io_tool_invalid_schema: The selected tool describes its arguments in a way that cannot be checked: its schema is not valid, or is of a draft Eneo does not support. Ask an administrator to contact whoever runs the tool's server, or choose another tool.
flow_error_typed_io_tool_not_allowed: This flow may not use the selected tool right now.
flow_error_typed_io_tool_classification_: The security classification of the tool's server changed after the run started. Start the run again.
flow_error_typed_io_tool_changed: The tool has changed since this flow was published. Publish the flow again to use the tool as it is now.
flow_error_typed_io_tool_invalid_argumen: The values sent to the tool do not fit what the tool accepts. Check the step's tool arguments.
flow_error_typed_io_tool_destination_blo: The tool's server address is not allowed for flows.
flow_error_typed_io_tool_connection_erro: The tool's server could not be reached, or the call failed.
flow_error_typed_io_tool_timeout: The tool did not answer in time.
flow_error_typed_io_tool_answer_too_larg: The tool's answer was too large to use in a step.
flow_error_typed_io_tool_malformed_answe: The step cannot read the tool's answer: it was empty, contained something other than text, or did not match the step's input type.
flow_error_typed_io_input_exceeds_model_: The material is too large for the selected model. Use smaller material, split the document, choose a model that handles more text, or choose Section by section under How the AI reads the material.
flow_error_typed_io_input_too_large: The step's material is too large. Reduce the text, files or content and start a new run.
flow_error_typed_io_structured_output_ex: The combined fixed-format answer is too large. Ask for shorter answers or process fewer items. A re-run also repeats calls that already finished.
flow_error_typed_io_invalid_file_type: An uploaded file has a file type this step does not support. Upload a file of the right type and start the run again.
flow_error_typed_io_invalid_input_source: The step combines material sources that cannot be used together. A flow editor needs to fix the step's material and publish the flow again. Then start a new run.

The step gets material from a step that cannot be used from this place in the flow. A flow editor needs to change the order of the steps or the material and publish the flow again. Then start a new run.
flow_error_typed_io_invalid_json_input: The step received data in a format it cannot read. Fix the material and start a new run.
flow_error_typed_io_invalid_output_mode_: The selected processing does not work with the step's material or result settings. A flow editor needs to adjust the step and publish the flow again. Then start a new run.
flow_error_typed_io_invalid_schema: The step's fixed answer format is invalid. Ask a flow editor to fix the format and publish the flow again.
flow_error_typed_io_missing_required_fil: Required files are missing. Add them and start the run again.
flow_error_typed_io_output_parse_failed: The model's answer, or a step's output value, could not be read as JSON in the expected fixed format: it is malformed or nested too deep. Adjust the instruction or the format and start a new run.
flow_error_typed_io_render_failed: The document could not be created. Check the step's answer and the document format before running again.
flow_error_typed_io_template_checksum_mi: The Word template changed after publishing. A flow editor needs to publish the flow again with the current template. Then start a new run.
flow_error_typed_io_template_render_fail: The Word template could not be filled in. Check the template fields and the step results they draw from.
flow_error_typed_io_transcript_too_large: The audio transcript is too large for this step. Use a shorter recording or split the audio into smaller runs.
flow_error_typed_io_transcription_config: The transcription settings are invalid. A flow editor needs to fix the language or model and publish the flow again. Then start a new run.
flow_error_typed_io_transcription_empty: Transcription produced no text. Use an audio file with speech and start the run again.
flow_error_typed_io_transcription_failed: The transcription service could not process the audio. Try again in a while, and contact an administrator if it keeps failing.
flow_error_typed_io_transcription_model_: No transcription model is selected. A flow editor needs to choose an available model and publish the flow again. Then start a new run.
The transcription model is unavailable. Choose another model or try again later.
flow_error_typed_io_speaker_service_unav: Speakers could not be identified: the flow's speaker identification service is missing or cannot be used in the space. Contact whoever manages the flow.
flow_error_typed_io_speaker_identificati: Speaker identification failed. Try again in a while. If the flow lets you choose, you can also run it without speaker identification. If it keeps failing, an administrator can test the service under Models.
flow_error_typed_io_transcription_not_en: Transcription is not turned on for your organization or this step. Ask an administrator to turn it on, or ask a flow editor to change the step's material type.
flow_error_typed_io_unsupported_type: The step's material type is not supported. A flow editor needs to change the type and publish the flow again. Then start a new run.
flow_error_flow_settings_invalid_payload: The settings were not saved: the request was empty, contradicted itself or held a value outside the allowed range. Check the values and save again.
flow_error_default_timeout_exceeds_tenan: The normal step time limit cannot be higher than the maximum step runtime (the technical deployment limit when no maximum is set). Lower the normal limit and save again.
flow_error_tenant_max_exceeds_env_hard_c: The maximum step runtime is higher than the technical deployment limit. Choose a lower value, or ask whoever operates Eneo to raise the limit.
flow_error_max_concurrent_runs_exceeds_s: Maximum concurrent flow runs cannot exceed the server capacity. Reload the page to see the current capacity.
flow_error_flow_mapped_execution_publish: A step in this flow runs once per file but has no limit on how many files it may process. Ask a flow editor to set the limit and publish the flow again.
flow_error_flow_step_name_reserved_varia: A step has a name that Eneo reserves for its own variables. Give the step a name that describes what it does and save again.
flow_error_flow_step_name_step_alias: A step has a name that looks like an automatic step reference such as step_1. Give the step a name that describes what it does and save again.
flow_error_flow_form_field_name_namespac: A form field has a technical name that is reserved for Eneo. Choose a more specific name and save again.
flow_error_flow_form_field_name_primary_: A form field has a technical name that Eneo already uses for what is sent in when the flow runs. Choose another name and save again.
flow_error_flow_form_field_name_step_ali: A form field has a technical name that looks like a step reference such as step_1. Choose another name and save again.
flow_error_flow_form_field_name_empty: A form field has no technical name. Give every form field a name and save again.
flow_error_flow_form_field_name_duplicat: Two form fields use the same technical name; upper and lower case count as the same. Give each field its own name and save again.
flow_error_flow_form_field_name_dot: A form field has a technical name that contains a dot. Use an underscore instead and save again.
flow_error_flow_form_field_name_template: A form field has a technical name that contains double curly brackets. Use a plain name without them and save again.
flow_error_flow_tool_options_too_large: The space offers more tools than the editor can list. A space administrator can switch off the MCP servers flows do not need.
flow_error_flow_template_too_large: The Word template is too large once unpacked or consists of too many parts. Use a smaller or simpler template and try again.
flow_error_stale_revision: The flow has changed since it was loaded, for example in another tab or by a colleague. Reload the page and redo your latest change.
flow_error_unknown_step_id: The change refers to a step that is not in the flow. Reload the page and redo your latest change.
flow_error_duplicate_step_id: The change contains the same step twice. Reload the page and redo your latest change.
flow_error_sentinel_secret_requires_step: A new step refers to a saved secret that only an existing step can have. Enter the secret value again and save.
flow_error_unsupported_media_type: This file type is not accepted for the flow. Choose a file of a type the flow accepts and try again.
flow_runtime_input_required_desc: Whoever runs the flow must upload at least one file.
flow_reading_mode_title: How the AI reads the material
flow_reading_mode_description: Choose whether the AI reads everything at once or works through long material section by section.
flow_reading_mode_whole_desc: The AI reads the whole material in one go. Suits answers that depend on the whole, such as a summary or an assessment.
flow_reading_mode_sections_desc: Long material is split into sections that the AI works through one at a time. Suits steps that pull tasks, decisions or actions out of a long text, such as a recording several hours long. Short material is still read in one go.
flow_reading_mode_summarize_desc: Each section is summarized on its own, then the summaries are merged until one whole remains.
flow_reading_mode_unavailable_output: Available when the step is an AI step that passes its answer on in a fixed format.
flow_reading_mode_unavailable_mapped: Cannot be combined with running the step per file or per record.
flow_reading_mode_sections_knowledge_not: This step has knowledge attached, but knowledge cannot be used when the AI reads the material in parts. Remove the knowledge or choose All at once, or the run stops at this step.
flow_step_citation_mode_desc: Controls whether the AI records which knowledge sources were used.
flow_step_input_type_tool_desc: How the step takes the tool's answer.
flow_step_review_policy_desc: Choose whether a person reviews the result before the run continues.
flow_step_review_policy_help: The following steps use the result as the reviewer approved or edited it. If the reviewer rejects it, the run is cancelled.
flow_step_review_policy_outbound_disable: Review is not available for steps that send their result on via HTTP.
flow_template_fill_json_warning: Choose text from a step or a single field from a fixed-format answer. Whole lists and groups of fields cannot be filled in as text.
flow_validation_msg_audio_source_unsuppo: Audio can only come from what is sent in when the flow runs. Choose that source for the step, or another material type.
flow_validation_msg_document_source_unsu: Documents can only come from what is sent in when the flow runs. Choose that source for the step, or another material type.
flow_validation_msg_file_source_unsuppor: Files can only come from what is sent in when the flow runs. Choose that source for the step, or another material type.
flow_validation_msg_flow_input_position_: Only the first step can read what is sent in.
flow_validation_msg_incompatible_type_ch: The material type does not match the previous step's result. Change the material type in the step, or the response format in the step before.
flow_validation_msg_invalid_input_source: This source cannot be used at this point in the flow.
This source cannot be used at this point in the flow.
flow_validation_msg_multiple_flow_input_: Only one step can use what is sent in.
flow_validation_msg_unsupported_type: This material type is not supported.
http_test_desc: Send a trial request to check that the address and authentication work.
http_test_credentials_require_https: Credentials require a fixed HTTPS server. Variables may be used in the path or query.
http_test_variable_resolution_failed: A test variable could not be resolved. Check the variable names and values.
http_test_saved_secret_unavailable: The saved credential is unavailable for this server. Re-enter it and save the step.
http_test_auth_missing: Enter the authentication credentials required by the service.
http_test_body_invalid: Enter a valid JSON request body.
http_test_body_not_allowed: A GET request cannot include a body.
http_test_timeout_invalid: Choose a timeout between 1 and 120 seconds.
http_test_needs_url: Enter an address above to run the test.
http_test_variables_help: JSON object used only for this test. Example key: base_url = https://api.example.com.
flow_validation_msg_http_post_not_termin: Send via HTTP can only be used in the flow's last step. Move the step to the end or choose another option under Result.
flow_validation_msg_input_binding_unsupp: The step refers to something that cannot be used here. The technical details show what.
flow_validation_msg_input_binding_future: The step references a later step. A step can only use results from earlier steps.
flow_validation_msg_input_binding_invali: The step references a step that cannot be used here.
flow_validation_msg_input_binding_unknow: The step references a step that does not exist in the flow.
flow_validation_msg_input_alias_not_rece: The step reads free text, but the person running the flow only provides form answers and files. Let the step read a form field or the uploaded material instead.
flow_validation_msg_duplicate_step_name: Two steps share the same name. Give each step a unique name.
flow_validation_msg_citation_mode_unsupp: Citations cannot be used with the step's current Result settings.
flow_validation_msg_template_fill_requir: The document template must be a Word file (.docx).
flow_validation_msg_output_contract_temp: The step's output contract does not fit the Word template. Fix it under Contracts and integrations in Advanced.
flow_validation_msg_review_policy_invali: The human review setting is invalid for this step.
flow_validation_msg_review_policy_outbou: Human review cannot be combined with Send via HTTP in this step.
flow_validation_msg_transcribe_only_viol: This step is limited to transcription and cannot carry other settings.
flow_validation_msg_audio_transcription_: To accept audio, transcription must be turned on.
Choose a transcription model to accept audio.
flow_validation_msg_input_binding_runtim: The step accepts files when the flow runs, but its own text under Material leaves them out. Add “The uploaded material” with Insert from the flow, or remove the own text.
flow_validation_msg_flow_step_invalid: The step's settings cannot be saved in their current combination. The technical details show the specifics.
flow_validation_msg_input_contract_inapp: An input contract cannot be used with the step's current settings. Remove it under Contracts and integrations in Advanced.
flow_validation_msg_input_contract_sourc: The step's input contract does not match the result of the step it reads. Fix one of the contracts under Contracts and integrations in Advanced.
flow_validation_msg_invalid_input_contra: The step's input contract is invalid. Fix it under Contracts and integrations in Advanced. The technical details show the specifics.
flow_validation_msg_invalid_output_contr: The step's output contract is invalid. Fix it under Contracts and integrations in Advanced. The technical details show the specifics.
flow_validation_msg_output_contract_type: The step's output contract does not fit its response format. Fix it under Contracts and integrations in Advanced.
flow_error_flow_run_invalid_label: The run name must be one line of at most 120 characters. Shorten it or leave it empty.
flow_run_error_review_policy_invalid_act: Open the affected steps, choose the review mode again or remove the review pause, publish the flow, and run it again.
flow_run_error_review_policy_invalid_sum: The run could not start because a review setting in the flow could not be parsed.
flow_run_evidence_view_bytes_omitted: “{section}” records not shown here: {count}. This view holds a limited amount. Those not shown are still stored.
flow_run_evidence_view_parent_omitted: “{section}” records not shown: {count}. The records they belong to are not shown here. They are still stored.
flow_run_evidence_view_rows_omitted: “{section}” records not shown here: {count}. This view holds a limited number. Those not shown are still stored.
flow_run_extracted_text_badge: Text read from the file: {count} characters
flow_run_knowledge_hidden_matched_explai: Passages retrieved during the run but not saved as evidence: {count}. The organisation's evidence settings, including “Passages per source”, control how much is saved.
flow_run_knowledge_passage_truncated: This passage is shortened: the end was not recorded.
flow_run_knowledge_passages_withheld: Passages not shown to you under your organization's confidentiality rules: {count}. The sources and counts remain visible.
flow_run_knowledge_passages_withheld_hin: Passages were recorded but are not shown to you under your organization's confidentiality rules.
flow_run_knowledge_source_empty_showing_: The source document is empty or deleted. The passages recorded during the run are shown below.
flow_run_knowledge_source_unavailable_sh: The source document cannot be read right now. The passages recorded during the run are shown below.
flow_run_knowledge_view_attempts_not_loa: Attempts not loaded in this view: {count}. Current attempts are prioritized, and evidence for the others is retained.
flow_run_knowledge_view_corrupt_passage_: Attempts whose recorded passage sizes cannot be read: {count}. Their retrieval evidence is not shown, and they are included in the not-loaded count. Evidence export is unavailable until the stored evidence is repaired.
flow_run_knowledge_view_current_attempts: Steps whose knowledge search could not be loaded within this view's limits: {count}, including step number {steps}. The results are still stored, so an empty list for these steps does not mean nothing was found.
flow_run_knowledge_view_omitted_passages: Passages not shown here: {omitted}. This keeps the view manageable. They are still stored and are included in an export.
flow_run_progress_next_step_hint: This step is next in the queue.
flow_run_progress_running_body: This step is running. When it is done, you can open its result here.
flow_run_progress_transcribing_with_spea: This step transcribes the audio and labels who says what.
flow_run_rejected_output_title: The answer that was not accepted
flow_run_review_original_help: This is the result before any reviewer edited it. Your changes are kept when you go back.
flow_run_review_payload_invalid: The edited result cannot be read as JSON. Check that brackets, quotation marks and commas are in place.
flow_run_sections_positions: Where each section sits in the material:
flow_run_sections_read_one: Read in one go because the material was short.
flow_run_knowledge_relevance_tooltip: How similar the passage is to the search query used during the run: {percent}%. The levels are approximate. The value shows what was retrieved, not how much the AI relied on it.
flow_run_more_reuse: Use the input from the last run
flow_run_more_reuse_files: Files are not reused. Pick them again.
flow_run_more_reuse_done: The input from the last run is filled in.
flow_run_more_reuse_failed: The input from the last run could not be read
flow_run_more_refreshed: The run is up to date.
flow_run_more_redacted_hint: API keys and bearer tokens are masked. The evidence can still contain personal data and text from the run.
flow_run_more_speakers_reduced: The speakers are set per passage, since the service could not place each word in the audio.
flow_run_more_speakers_skipped: Speaker identification was skipped: the transcription gave no text.
flow_run_more_attempts_failed: The step's attempts could not be read
flow_run_more_attempts_none: The step has no recorded attempts.
flows_chat_model_default_saved: The chat now follows the default model {model}.
flows_chat_new_conversation_description: The chat starts over without what has been said so far. The old conversation is kept but no longer used. The flow and its changes are not affected.
flows_chat_new_conversation_failed: Could not start a new conversation
flows_chat_new_conversation_after_pause: Edit mode is on. It has been a while, so the chat started a new conversation.
flow_admin_chat_group_description: The chat that reads and changes flows for the people who build them.
flow_admin_chat_model_description: Used in new chats and in chats where the person has not chosen a model, in spaces that allow the model. Otherwise the space's default model is used. Only models that can use tools are listed.
flow_error_flow_authoring_chat_no_model: The space has no model that can use tools. Ask a space administrator to enable one.
flow_error_flow_authoring_model_not_in_s: The model is not enabled in the space. Choose another model or use the default.
flow_error_flow_authoring_model_below_cl: The model is not approved for the space's security classification. Choose another model or use the default.
flow_error_flow_authoring_model_without_: The model cannot use tools, which the chat needs to read and change the flow. Choose another model.
flow_error_flow_authoring_model_unavaila: The model is not enabled in the organisation. Choose another model.
flow_error_flow_authoring_reasoning_effo: The model does not offer that reasoning effort. Choose another level or the model's default.
flow_runs_sensitive_title: Sensitive flow: limited access before approval
flow_runs_sensitive_body: Until the result is finally approved, only the person who uploaded the material and specifically authorised reviewers may handle the content and evidence.
flow_runs_summary_ready: Everything required is ready. Check the details and start the run, or go back to change them.
flow_runs_summary_empty: Nothing is filled in for this run.
flow_run_sections_read_each: Read part by part: {count} parts. Each part gave one entry in the result, in the order of the material.
flow_run_sections_read_summarized: Read part by part: {count} parts, summarized step by step into one result.
flow_editor_tools_long_material_result_d: One combined answer from the parts' notes
flow_run_dialog_close_confirm_message: Uploaded files and filled-in fields are lost if you close the dialog.
flow_run_knowledge_status_no_chunks: No matches in the knowledge source
flow_run_knowledge_status_skipped: Skipped: this step does not search knowledge
flow_run_knowledge_filter_sources_limit_: Showing the first {shown} of {total} matching sources. Refine the search to find more.
flow_run_knowledge_mapped_fan_out_incomp: This step stopped before every call ran. The evidence below covers the calls that completed.
flow_run_knowledge_passage_detail_partia: Passages were recorded for {detailed} of {total} sources.
flow_runs_empty_description_unpublished: This flow has not run yet. Publish it first, then you can run it.
flow_run_more_run_id_hint: The run's id. It is needed, for example, when a legal hold should cover specific runs.
flow_run_more_trace_id_hint: A unique reference to the run's logs. Give it to support if you contact them about this run.
flow_runs_usage_tokens_explainer: Tokens are the small pieces of text the AI model reads and writes. The count covers every call to the model, retries included, and comes from the service or is estimated. Incomplete means the count is missing for at least one call.
admin_issued_password_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the password and copy it yourself.
